description: For every finite propositional context \(\Gamma\) and formula \(C\), a derivation of falsum from \(\Gamma\) gives a derivation of \(C\) from \(\Gamma\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Derives.falsumElim.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α]
  {Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)} {A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α} :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Derives Γ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula.falsum →
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Derives Γ A
